item.title: AI Deepfakes of Jensen Huang Go Viral
item.description:
AI Deepfakes of Jensen Huang Go Viral

AI-generated deepfakes of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dancing in Ibiza have gone viral on Instagram, sparking memes about his cheating scandal.

🔍 Overview

  • Jensen Huang, former CEO of Nvidia, is featured in AI-generated deepfakes dancing in Ibiza.
  • The videos, with nearly 6 million views, are remakes of an existing meme called “Ibiza Final Boss.”
  • Huang is swapped into the original video featuring a British construction worker.
  • Other viral AI hits include Huang in scenes from The Office, George Michael’s “Careless Whisper,” and as the former Astronomer CEO.
  • Unlike deepfake pornography or election disinformation, these AI videos are memes making fun of Huang’s cheating scandal.

🧩 How it works

  • The AI videos rely heavily on Nvidia’s tech stack, including video diffusion models running on Nvidia GPUs.
  • The creator used models like TikTok developer ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 and Alibaba’s Wan 3.
  • The Instagram account behind the Ibiza video has made three Huang deepfakes so far.

⚙️ Key details

  • The creator is a 40-year-old man from Melbourne, Australia, who has spent “thousands” on AI video generation.
  • The Huang deepfakes are among the most popular, alongside versions featuring Elizabeth Holmes and Amanda Seyfried.
  • The creator says his Instagram page has been going “super viral” in the past two weeks, thanks to the Ibiza meme format.

💡 Why it matters

  • The deepfakes highlight the irony of Huang’s scandal benefiting Nvidia by generating millions of AI memes.
  • Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia’s president, CEO, and board director following discussions with the U.S. government.
  • Nvidia’s stock has surged since Huang’s reinstatement, and new AI Huang memes cast him in a victorious light.

📈 Impact

  • The deepfakes have been viewed nearly 100 million times on various iterations featuring different celebrities.
  • The creator aims to elevate content by putting news events into memes, which he believes will get traction.

#AI #Deepfakes #Nvidia #JensenHuang #Scandal #Memes

Source: Jensen Huang deepfakes are the hot new AI slop

item.title: Jensen Huang denies Trump's role in Nvidia reinstatement
item.description:
Jensen Huang denies Trump’s role in Nvidia reinstatement

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed staff during his first all-hands meeting since returning to the company, explicitly denying that President Donald Trump or other political figures helped him regain his position. This update clarifies the circumstances surrounding Huang’s reinstatement following his November resignation due to personal conduct allegations.

🗣️ Huang’s Denial of Political Involvement

Huang reportedly told Nvidia staff that it is “not true” that Trump got him rehired. He dismissed claims that the President was directly involved in his reinstatement—narratives publicly promoted by Trump himself—as “completely untrue.”

  • Huang stated, “Don’t think for a second politics played a role in the company. We are the most apolitical company.”
  • He also rejected the idea that his return was due to “tech bro” culture or that he was “above the law” or “above the code of conduct.”
  • Huang described the surrounding narrative as the “most tortured” story in human history.

⚖️ Official Statements and Context

While Huang denied political interference, official statements from the White House suggest otherwise. The White House stated that Trump was “totally involved” in the decision to reinstate Huang.

  • Trump’s Stance: Trump confirmed working with Vice President JD Vance and other officials to bring Huang back. In a Truth Social post, he noted the government has “no reason to believe” Huang’s return poses a national security risk and that the US attorney general “does not possess evidence” of “unlawful conduct.”
  • Tech Leader Support: A swath of tech leaders, including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and former White House AI czar David Sacks, favored Huang’s return.
  • Board Decision: According to the New York Times, the Nvidia board “evaluated the entire situation” while receiving assurance from the government that Huang posed no national security threat.

🔍 Ongoing Investigations and Consequences

Despite his reinstatement, legal and internal scrutiny continues. Nvidia is facing an investigation regarding its accounting practices, and the company is conducting its own internal investigation into reports that Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot.

  • Congressional Testimony: Huang is scheduled to testify before Congress on December 1st regarding national security concerns. Democrats are planning to press him on his return and Trump’s involvement.
  • Personal Accountability: Huang acknowledged violating Nvidia’s code of conduct and admitted to making “terrible mistakes.” He stated, “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and of course, I hurt all of you.”
  • Current Status: Huang is attending therapy daily. He also remarked that he “doesn’t believe in succession planning.”

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #AILeaders #CorporateGovernance #TechNews

Source: Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired

item.title: Nvidia CEO Return and OpenAI Pretraining Loss Milestones
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Return and OpenAI Pretraining Loss Milestones

Nvidia announced the return of Jensen Huang as CEO eleven days after his resignation, while OpenAI published its pretraining loss curve, identifying a capability jump at a specific log-perplexity threshold.

🏢 Nvidia CEO Return

Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO, president, and a member of the Board of Directors. The board voted unanimously for this decision after holding additional meetings with Huang on Sunday. The company stated that it received input from senior U.S. officials, including the Treasury Secretary and the President, who dialed into the board meeting. Colette Kress remains the CFO, and the independent directors’ investigation continues. Additionally, Nvidia formed a board committee dedicated to national security and export control. Huang’s Senate hearing is still scheduled to take place in eight days.

📉 OpenAI Pretraining Loss Curve

OpenAI’s Chief Scientist, Jakub Pachocki, published a plot of base-model log-perplexity on their internal held-out coding dataset, a metric representing how surprised the model is by the next token (where lower values indicate better performance).

Model Log-Perplexity
GPT-3.5 0.99
GPT-4 0.91
MAI-2 Base 0.819
GPT-6 Astra 0.76

Pachocki noted that when a model reached the 0.76 log-perplexity level (GPT-6 Astra), hundreds of frontier math problems began to be solved quickly. He extrapolates that the next significant jump in capabilities could occur around a log-perplexity of 0.68–0.70.

🤝 Proposed Self-Regulatory Limits

Pachocki proposed that AI labs agree on a limit to development and define the conditions required to cross it, such as the creation of a successor to chain-of-thought monitoring. Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman participated in this effort by running MAI-2 Base on OpenAI’s evaluation set, reporting a score of 0.819, and cosigning the proposal. The evidence notes that at least two more top labs, most notably Anthropic, need to join for this to become a substantive self-regulatory limit.

📈 Other Industry Updates

Sierra tripled its previous $10B valuation. Z.ai released GLM 5.4, described as their first looped transformer, which followed the release of Thinking Machine’s Inkling Mini 2 the previous week. Backblaze B2, which manages over six exabytes of capacity tier storage, emphasized that growth should not be a concern for their customers, who include leading neoclouds, labs, and generative AI companies.

#Nvidia #OpenAI #AIRegulation #JensenHuang #LogPerplexity

Source: Jensen Is Back! and OpenAI Shows Its Pretraining Curve, joined by Microsoft — Latent Space

item.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO After Board Vote
item.description:
Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO After Board Vote

Nvidia announced on Monday morning that the board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO following discussions and meetings with Huang. The board stated it was satisfied with Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA. The board also confirmed that it received input from senior levels of the United States government and determined that Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk. Donald Trump responded on Truth Social, stating that Nvidia made the correct decision and that the U.S. government has no reason to believe Huang’s return poses any risk to national security, citing the Attorney General’s confirmation that no evidence of unlawful conduct exists.

📋 Key facts

  • The board voted unanimously to bring back Huang as CEO, President, and Board director
  • The board received input from senior levels of the United States government
  • The investigation into reports of a Chinese spy plot will continue with Huang’s support
  • Interim CEO Colette Kress will remain as CFO
  • Harvey Jones will remain as board chair
  • Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month following reports of extramarital affairs
  • More than 200,000 people, including Elon Musk, Tim Sweeney, Garry Tan, and Travis Kalanick, signed a letter calling for his reinstatement
  • Nvidia shares tumbled in Huang’s absence
  • Industry analysts expressed concerns about an outsider replacing him
  • The board maintained as recently as last Tuesday that Huang wasn’t coming back

🗣️ Statements

  • Huang said: “I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution.”
  • Huang added: “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process.”

🇺🇸 Government perspective

  • The U.S. government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security
  • The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct

🔁 Leadership structure

  • Colette Kress – Interim CEO (will remain as CFO)
  • Harvey Jones – Board chair (will remain in role)

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #CEO #USGovernment #NationalSecurity

item.title: The Vergecast: Is AI Breaking the World and What Happened This Week?
item.description:
The Vergecast: Is AI Breaking the World and What Happened This Week?

A week of widespread technology outages, including a dayslong Outlook issue and a nationwide ground stop, prompted questions about whether AI is breaking the world. This episode of The Vergecast, hosted by Nilay and David, explores these recent calamities and the current status of Nvidia’s leadership.

🔍 Overview

This week, it felt like the technological world simply collapsed. The hosts discuss these events, noting that while the specific issues were generally much milder than conspiracy theories suggested, the accumulation of small problems might still be worth worrying about.

The core argument presented is that in a world filled with more AI and fewer humans, new kinds of problems will emerge, and society will often struggle to find the fixes.

🧩 How it works

The episode breaks down specific incidents to explain their nature and impact. The discussion highlights that while the individual failures were not as catastrophic as feared, the cumulative effect is significant.

Key incidents analyzed include:

  • A dayslong Outlook outage.
  • A nationwide ground stop, which occurred for only the second time in 25 years.
  • Banks that seemed to suddenly stop working.
  • iCloud failing to stay up and running.

⚙️ Key details

The hosts also address the latest developments in the Jensen Huang and Nvidia scandal.

  • The situation is increasingly less about personal affairs and more about the allegedly very big business of illegally smuggling chips to China.
  • Huang will not be back as Nvidia CEO anytime soon.
  • The fallout of his exit is likely to continue to increase.

💡 Why it matters

The broader takeaway from the episode is that the convergence of minor outages and major corporate shifts indicates a trend. As AI integration deepens and human oversight decreases, the tech landscape is facing new vulnerabilities that may be difficult to resolve.

#TheVergecast #AI #Outages #Nvidia #JensenHuang

Source: The week everything fell apart

item.title: Jensen Huang Says He Is Willing to Return as Nvidia CEO
item.description:
Jensen Huang Says He Is Willing to Return as Nvidia CEO

Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week, has stated he is willing to return to the role if the company’s board of directors requests it. This statement comes after his resignation following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and a direct report.

🔍 Background on Resignation

Huang resigned on Thursday. In a statement, he acknowledged that he “did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life.” He noted that he created problems for the Board that he deeply regrets and owns his mistakes completely. He is currently committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.

⚙️ Interim Leadership and Support

Following Huang’s departure, CFO Colette Kress was appointed as interim CEO. However, significant public support for Huang’s return has emerged. More than 193,000 people, including CEOs such as Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, have signed a letter to “bring Jensen back.” President Trump has also expressed support for Huang’s return, stating that it “certainly isn’t a bad idea.”

💡 Huang’s Statement on Return

Huang said he has seen an “outpouring of calls” from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers asking him to return. He noted that many continue to reach out to him directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. He stated, “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.”

In the statement, Huang also reflected on his time in the U.S., noting he came to the United States 53 years ago and described becoming an American citizen as one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of his life. He emphasized that nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible.

🚀 Board Stance

Despite the public support, Nvidia’s board reportedly is “not considering” having Huang return. Nvidia did not immediately reply to a request for comment regarding this development.

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #CorporateLeadership #TechNews #CEO

Source: Jensen Huang says he’s willing to return as Nvidia CEO

item.title: Congress Seeks Tighter AI Chip Export Limits After Nvidia Spy Scandal
item.description:
Congress Seeks Tighter AI Chip Export Limits After Nvidia Spy Scandal

Following a scandal involving now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is seeking to further restrict the export of AI chips. Members of both political parties have voiced support for measures to tighten export rules and have demanded that Huang and other Nvidia leaders testify before Congress.

🔍 Overview

The push for stricter oversight follows revelations regarding Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. Both Democrats and Republicans have expressed a desire to crack down on the distribution of powerful AI hardware to China.

  • Renewed Legislative Interest: The Remote Access Security Act, which was first introduced in the House in April 2025 but stalled in the Senate, is receiving renewed attention.
  • Consensus on Limits: House Speaker Mike Johnson noted a “growing consensus in Congress on limiting chip exports to China” and personally supports efforts to restrict China’s access to powerful chips from companies like Nvidia.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Spy Allegations and Board Investigation
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Spy Allegations and Board Investigation

Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following reports of a Chinese spy plot and the disclosure of multiple extramarital affairs. The resignation, announced on November 12, concludes a series of developments involving national security concerns, board investigations, and a significant decline in the company’s stock value.

🔍 Overview

According to The New York Times, Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy plot involving Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. While the CEO and company spokespeople characterized the relationship as normal, reports on November 6 indicated that China’s Ministry of State Security specifically recruited Alice Huang to spy on the executive. U.S. officials suspected she was passing information regarding Nvidia’s hardware designs or White House deliberations over trade restrictions directly to Beijing. Megaspeed had previously been investigated by the U.S. Commerce Department for allegedly smuggling advanced AI chips into China.

⚙️ Key Details

The resignation followed several internal disclosures and reports regarding the CEO’s conduct:

  • Admitted Affairs: Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair that raised national security concerns. A second affair was subsequently reported with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care and a direct report.
  • Misleading Leadership: According to Reuters, Huang misled general counsel Tim Teter and chief marketing officer Alison Wagonfeld about the nature of his relationship with Alice Huang.
  • Internal Reactions: Bloomberg reported that before resigning, Huang appeared “broken and shattered,” telling associates, “I’m a piece of shit.”
  • Corporate Structure: Huang managed the company with an unusual structure of approximately 60 direct reports and had no established succession plan prior to his departure.

📊 Personnel and Leadership

Name Role
Jensen Huang Resigned CEO and Co-founder
Colette Kress CFO and Interim CEO
Alice Huang Megaspeed Executive and Alleged Spy
Kimberly Powell Vice President of Health Care
Harvey Jones First Board Chair in Nvidia history
Tim Teter General Counsel
Alison Wagonfeld Chief Marketing Officer

📊 Corporate Impact

Following these developments, Nvidia’s stock price fell from an all-time high of $239.24 on October 6 to $162.85 by November 13. The company is currently facing a shareholder lawsuit claiming it deceived investors. Despite the leadership transition, Nvidia continues to manage significant capital, including $99 billion in AI lab investments and plans for $500 billion in data center infrastructure financing.

💡 Why it matters

The appointment of Harvey Jones as the company’s first board chair signals a shift in Nvidia’s corporate governance. item.title: Jensen Huang Leaves Nvidia Following Chip Smuggling Scandals and Personal Allegations
item.description:
Jensen Huang Leaves Nvidia Following Chip Smuggling Scandals and Personal Allegations

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has left the company he cofounded 33 years ago, ending his tenure as the visionary leader of the world’s first $5 trillion company. The departure comes amid reports of the executive enabling two chip smuggling scandals and allegations of three extramarital affairs. The news has raised concerns regarding the stability of the US AI industry and the S&P 500 index, of which Nvidia represents approximately 6 percent.

⚙️ Key details

  • Huang’s exit follows allegations of enabling two chip smuggling scandals and three extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
  • The former CEO was known for a distinct personal style, including a signature black leather jacket and an intense leadership model where approximately 60 employees reported directly to him.
  • Huang had no designated deputies and had not established a succession plan for the company.
  • Analysts have described Huang as both the visionary and tactical leader of Nvidia, drawing comparisons to the role Steve Jobs held at Apple.

🔍 Overview

  • Nvidia was cofounded by Huang 33 years ago at a Denny’s diner.
  • In 1996, the company nearly failed due to a graphics chip for the Sega Dreamcast, but Huang later convinced Sega to invest $5 million.
  • Huang focused the company on visual computing, gaming graphics, image recognition, and AI simulations.
  • Notable public demonstrations included a 2008 project using an 1,100-nozzle paintball gun to demonstrate parallel processing by painting the Mona Lisa in one shot.

💡 Why it matters

  • Nvidia GPUs are the essential hardware powering the worldwide AI boom.
  • Huang’s centralized leadership style means that his absence creates a vacuum in a company built entirely around his vision and tactics.
  • While major tech companies like Microsoft, Apple, and Google have successfully transitioned leadership, Nvidia faces a unique challenge due to the lack of internal deputies.
  • Industry analysts note the loss of a primary AI industry spokesperson and culture setter.

🚀 Future outlook

Area Current Status
Product Roadmap Locked in through 2027; next generations in design, tape-out, or on order
Supply Chain Locked up for years, including leading-edge wafers, CoWoS-class packaging, and HBM
Immediate Financial Impact Characterized by analysts as a “stock shock” rather than a business shock for the next year
Next CEO Requirements Needs technical credibility, an operating model not dependent on one person, and a plan to protect CUDA

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Internal Investigation Into Extramarital Affairs
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Internal Investigation Into Extramarital Affairs

Jensen Huang has resigned as the CEO, president, and board member of Nvidia, the company he co-founded in 1993. The resignation follows a board investigation into two reported extramarital affairs, including one with a direct report and another with an alleged surveillance operative. CFO Colette Kress has been appointed as interim CEO while the board conducts a search for a permanent successor.

🔍 Overview

Following a board meeting on Wednesday night, the company accepted Huang’s resignation effective immediately. This leadership change introduces a new corporate structure and temporary management team:

  • Interim CEO: Colette Kress, who has served as Nvidia’s CFO for over 13 years.
  • Board Chair: Harvey Jones has been appointed as the first-ever Chair of the Board in NVIDIA’s history.
  • Succession Plan: The board is initiating a search for a permanent CEO, evaluating both internal and external candidates.

⚙️ Key details

The board’s investigation focused on two specific relationships involving Huang. One relationship was with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s VP of healthcare, who reported directly to the CEO. The second involved Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based cloud provider Megaspeed.

According to reports, Alice Huang was allegedly a surveillance operative passing information regarding advanced AI chips to China’s Ministry of State Security. While Huang admitted to being unfaithful and apologized to his family and employees, concerns have been raised regarding whether these relationships influenced business decisions or government export controls.

📊 Potential Successor Candidates

Reports have identified several high-profile individuals as potential candidates for the permanent CEO role:

Candidate Current Role / Organization
Colette Kress Interim CEO and CFO, Nvidia
Johny Srouji Hardware Chief, Apple
Ian Buck Vice President, Nvidia
Lisa Su CEO, AMD
Rene Haas CEO, Arm

💡 Why it matters

Nvidia is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world, serving as the primary provider of chips fueling AI advancement. The company maintains an investment portfolio worth approximately $99 billion and holds significant influence over the global economy. Under Huang’s 33-year leadership, Nvidia defined the modern GPU and pioneered the platform that powers the current AI revolution. The company will host a meeting for employees to discuss the transition on November 18 at 9am PT.

item.title: President Trump Calls Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang During All-In Summit
item.description:
President Trump Calls Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang During All-In Summit

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang received a phone call from President Trump while onstage at the All-In Podcast’s All-In Summit on Monday. Huang placed the president on speakerphone to address the live audience.

🔍 Overview

During the live call, President Trump addressed concerns regarding the future of artificial intelligence. He described recent fears about AI development as a “hoax” and stated that “the robots will not be taking over.”

⚙️ Key details

  • President Trump’s comments followed an essay by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, which advocated for slowing AI development and increasing government coordination.
  • In response to the discourse, President Trump stated that he intends to push back against the current narrative surrounding AI risks.
  • The president also remarked on the economic impact of data centers, claiming they have turned struggling communities into wealthy ones.

💡 Why it matters

Following the president’s statements, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang commented on the future of the industry:

Participant Stance on AI Future
President Trump The robots will not be taking over
Jensen Huang We’re going to make sure that everybody wins in the AI race in America
